digo: Mmangwi; Mmangitovu / Mmangi tovu; Mmangwimangwi (App. VI)
other_mijikenda: Duruma, Giriama: mmangwi; Duruma: mmangi tovu, mmangwimangwi (Pakia App. VI)

teaser.en: One shrub, four Digo names, and one of them shared with a different neighbour.
teaser.sw: Kichaka kimoja, majina manne ya Kidigo, na moja kati yake linashirikiwa na jirani mwingine.
teaser.dg: Chitsaka chimwenga, madzina mane ga Chidigo, na dzina mwenga kahi yao ni ra jirani wanjina tafwauti.

summary.en: This mmangwi is a coastal shrub of the coffee family with small white flowers and small berries. Pakia records several forms of its name.
summary.sw: Mmangwi huu ni kichaka cha pwani cha familia ya mibuni chenye maua madogo meupe na beri ndogo. Pakia anaandika maumbo kadhaa ya jina lake.
summary.dg: *Mmangwi* uhu ni chitsaka cha pwani cha jamii ya kahawa, chenye maruwa madide mereru na matunda madide. Pakia anaandika madzinage kpwa njira nyinji.

about.en: This *mmangwi* is a shrub or small tree of the coffee family. It has opposite, oval, glossy leaves, small white or cream flowers clustered at the leaf bases, and small round fruits that ripen to red or orange.
about.sw: *Mmangwi* huu ni kichaka au mti mdogo wa familia ya mibuni. Una majani ya duaradufu yanayong'aa yanayoota kwa jozi zinazotazamana, maua madogo meupe au ya rangi ya krimu yaliyokusanyika kwenye vishina vya majani, na matunda madogo ya mviringo yanayoiva na kuwa mekundu au ya rangi ya chungwa.
about.dg: *Mmangwi* uhu ni chitsaka au muhi mdide wa jamii ya kahawa. Una makodza ga mviringo ganayomera mairi-mairi ganalolana na ganayong'ala, maruwa madide mereru au ga rangi ya maziya ganayomera mafungu-mafungu phatu milita ya makodza inaphoandzira, na matunda madide ga mviringo ganayoivwa kukala ga kundu au ga rangi ya chungbwa.

where.en: It grows in coastal bush and forest of eastern Africa, including the Kenya coast.
where.sw: Unaota katika vichaka na misitu ya pwani mashariki mwa Afrika, ikiwemo pwani ya Kenya.
where.dg: Unamera weruni na kpwenye matsaka ga pwani ya Afrika ya mashariki, phamwenga na pwani ya Kenya.

names.en: Pakia records this plant under *mmangwi*, a name shared with *Polysphaeria multiflora*, and also as *mmangitovu* or *mmangi tovu* and *mmangwimangwi*. Duruma and Giriama share *mmangwi*, and Duruma shares the other two forms. Pakia does not explain the names. There is no English or Swahili name in the sources: the 'Mmangitovu' that appears in the English column of Pakia's list is another Digo name.
names.sw: Pakia anaandika mmea huu chini ya *mmangwi*, jina linaloshirikiwa na *Polysphaeria multiflora*, na pia kama *mmangitovu* au *mmangi tovu* na *mmangwimangwi*. Kiduruma na Kigiriama hutumia *mmangwi*, na Kiduruma hutumia pia maumbo yale mengine mawili. Pakia hayaelezi majina haya. Vyanzo havitoi jina la Kiingereza wala la Kiswahili: 'Mmangitovu' linaloonekana katika safu ya Kiingereza ya orodha ya Pakia ni jina lingine la Kidigo.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika mmea uhu photsi ya *mmangwi*, dzina ambaro piya ni ra *Polysphaeria multiflora*, na piya dza *mmangitovu* au *mmangi tovu* na *mmangwimangwi*. Aduruma na Agiryama piya anahumira *mmangwi*, na Aduruma anahumira madzina higa mairi ganjina piya. Pakia kaeleza mana ya madzina higa. Kpwenye vitabu takuna dzina ra Chingereza wala ra Chiswahili: dzina 'Mmangitovu' rinaroonekana kpwenye mstari wa Chingereza wa madzina ga Pakia ni dzina ranjina ra Chidigo.

reason.en: Polysphaeria, which shares the name mmangwi
